desc: Key Applications: Telco Edge, Cloud Service Providers, Open-RAN, Artificial Intelligence (AI) on Edge
Key Features: Single Socket Ampere® AmpereOne® Processor (Up to 192 Cores; Up to 3.2Ghz) ; Up to 400W TDP
16 DIMMs; Up to 4TB ECC Registered DDR5-5600/ 4800MHz RDIMM/LRDIMM

Supports 1 PCIe 5.0 x16 Double Wide FPFL GPU Card (or 1 PCIe 5.0 x16 FPFL Single Slot and 1 PCIe 5.0 x8 FPFL Single Slot), 1 PCIe 5.0 x16 FPHL Slot, 1 PCIe 5.0 x8 FPHL Slot, 1 PCIe 5.0 x16 LP Slot, 1 AIOM Slot (OCP3.0 Mezzanine Compatible)
2x 25Gb LAN SFP28 Ports via BCM57414 Controller w/NC-SI
1600W Redundant Titanium Level High-efficiency Power Supplies
1 VGA, 1 (Serial) Micro USB Port, 2 USB3.0 (2 Rear).
